title: MarkFlow Canonical Fixture Manifest
description: Machine-readable manifest of phase-2 canonical Markdown fixtures. Each entry records a category, the source of the file (canonical = maintained as a phase-2 canonical fixture, core = inherited from the Core lossless suite), and a sha256 hash of the file bytes. All fixture files live under markflow-core/fixtures and are committed to git (including the size fillers).

categories.description: Fixed category vocabulary. Every fixture entry's category must be one of these.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the fixture file.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the file bytes on disk.

sizeBytes.description: Target size in bytes (size category only).

generator.description: Deterministic generator parameters for regenerating size fixtures. Reserved for future use; current size fixtures are committed directly to git.
